$comment: Describes the parsed plugin.toml. The Rust app (manifest.rs) is the authority and the CLI validator (sdk/cli/src/manifest.mjs) mirrors it; this file mirrors both for editors and docs. Rules a schema cannot express stay in code: unique command, panel and importer ids, that an onDrop:<ext> activation event names an extension an importer declares (the schema only requires some importer), that importer extensions are unique across the plugin's importers, that the file named by main exists, id collisions with other installed plugins, dev = true in a packaged manifest (error dev-true), min_app lower than the @since of the API the code uses, the 64 KB size limit of the file, and that main is at most 260 bytes (the schema counts characters). The schema is stricter than the validator in one place: settings must have title and default, because the settings registry rejects a missing default.
title: Vaultdraw plugin manifest (plugin.toml)
description: The manifest of a Vaultdraw plugin: one plugin.toml next to main.js.

id.title: Plugin id
id.description: Unique id. 2 to 39 characters of a-z, 0-9 and -, not starting with -. Full command ids are "<id>.<command id>".

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name. 1 to 200 characters, not blank.

version.title: Version
version.description: The plugin's own semantic version, for example 1.0.0.

api.title: API level
api.description: The plugin API level this plugin targets. The app refuses any level it does not implement. Level 0 is experimental.

min_app.title: Minimum app version
min_app.description: Optional. Semantic version of the oldest Vaultdraw app that can run the plugin. Older apps refuse it.

main.title: Entry file
main.description: Relative path of the ESM bundle inside the plugin folder, with / separators. No .., no ., no empty segment, no leading /, no backslash, no colon. At most 260 bytes.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional. One line about the plugin. At most 1000 characters.

author.title: Author
author.description: Optional. Who made the plugin. At most 1000 characters.

activation.title: Activation events
activation.description: Optional. By default a plugin loads on first use: one of its commands runs or one of its panels opens, or a file with an extension one of its importers declares is dropped or picked. List "onStartupFinished" to also activate it on an idle callback after startup. "onDrop:<ext>" is accepted only for an extension an importer declares, and adds nothing the importer does not already do. No other event exists.

items.title: Activation event
items.description: The event name: onStartupFinished, or onDrop:<ext> for a declared importer extension.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Optional. What the plugin does to your files, shown in the enable dialog. A declaration and a consent record, not a sandbox: the app loads the plugin only while you have confirmed what it declares, and asks again when an update adds a write permission. At most 8. The names net, secret and control are reserved and refused for now.

items.title: Permission
items.description: vault.read reads the drawings in your vault. vault.write creates drawings in your vault.

dev.title: Development mode
dev.description: Optional. true makes the app reload the plugin when its files change. `vaultdraw-plugin dev` adds it to the installed copy. A packaged plugin must not set it to true (error dev-true).

contributes.title: Contributions
contributes.description: What the plugin adds to the app. The app registers stubs for these without loading any plugin code.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Palette commands, written as [[contributes.commands]]. At most 200.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Side panels, written as [[contributes.panels]]. At most 20.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings the plugin declares, written as [[contributes.settings]]. At most 100.

importers.title: Importers
importers.description: File kinds the plugin imports, written as [[contributes.importers]]. At most 8. The app registers them without loading any plugin code; the plugin loads when a matching file is dropped or picked.

^x-.title: Tool extension table
^x-.description: Tables named x-* belong to tools. The app and the CLI ignore them.

importer.title: Importer
importer.description: A file kind the plugin imports. Register its handler with ctx.importers.register in activate(). Files whose name ends in one of the extensions go to it; the longest matching extension wins.

id.title: Importer id
id.description: Short id, unique among the plugin's importers. Same rule as a command id.

title.title: Importer title
title.description: Shown on the Plugins page and in messages about skipped files. 1 to 200 characters, not blank.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Lower case file extensions without the leading dot, for example "txt" or "tar.gz". 1 to 8, unique in the plugin. Each is lower case letters and digits with dots between parts, at most 32 bytes. Extensions the app handles itself are refused: excalidraw, excalidrawlib, json, pdf, jpeg, svg, png, jpg, gif, webp, bmp, ico, avif, jfif, excalidraw.png and excalidraw.svg.

command.title: Command
command.description: A command declared in plugin.toml. Bind its handler with ctx.commands.register in activate().

id.title: Command id
id.description: Short id, unique among the plugin's commands. Letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter, at most 64 characters. The full id is "<plugin id>.<id>".

title.title: Command title
title.description: Shown in the palette. 1 to 200 characters, not blank.

keys.title: Default keys
keys.description: Optional default chords in config notation, for example "Mod+Alt+H". An empty list means none. Users can rebind them.

when.title: Context keys
when.description: Optional. Built-in or namespaced context keys that must hold for the command to be available, for example "vaultOpen".

palette.title: In the palette
palette.description: Optional, default true. false hides the command from the command palette.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: A panel declared in plugin.toml. Bind its React component with ctx.panels.register in activate().

id.title: Panel id
id.description: Short id, unique among the plugin's panels. Same rule as a command id. The full id is "<plugin id>.<id>".

title.title: Panel title
title.description: Shown on the panel and its activity-bar button. 1 to 200 characters, not blank.

group.title: Activity-bar group
group.description: Optional, default "top". Where the button sits in the activity bar.

setting.title: Setting
setting.description: A setting the plugin declares. Values live in [plugin.<id>] tables of config.toml, or in the vault's settings.toml for vault scope. A stored value outside min and max, or of the wrong type, reads as the default.

key.title: Key
key.description: The setting's name inside the plugin. Unique among its settings.

type.title: Type
type.description: bool: true or false. int: whole number. number: any finite number. string: text. select: one of options. color: a color string.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional. Help text under the label.

default.title: Default
default.description: The value used when nothing is stored. It must fit type, min, max and options.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Optional. Lowest allowed value of an int or number setting.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Optional. Highest allowed value of an int or number setting.

options.title: Options
options.description: select only. The choices, as inline tables with value and label.

label.title: Label
label.description: The text shown to the user.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Optional. The layers that may hold a value. Default: both global and vault.
